candidates.maintenance_evidence: DeepParse 0.10.0 was released 2026-02-28; its repository was active in 2026-08

candidates.offline_capability: SUPPORTED after all public package/model/embedding assets are acquired and frozen; AddressParser offline=True and local-files-only loading

attention model has the strongest published DeepParse BPEmb zero-shot result for Japan among its BPEmb configurations

direct address-level evaluation is absent for Lao, Thai, and Hebrew and weak for Japan; applicability there is experimental, not established
the BPEmb encoder internally lowercases and replaces digits with zero for feature lookup; SAFE will pass and preserve the exact candidate and will not add preprocessing

script_scope.Han: LIMITED_DIRECT_EVIDENCE: Japan is a published zero-shot country and performs poorly; multilingual BPEmb includes Japanese and Chinese scripts
script_scope.Hangul: DIRECT_EVIDENCE: South Korea is a training/evaluation country and an official Hangul inference example is published
script_scope.Hebrew: EMBEDDING_LEVEL_ONLY: Hebrew is in BPEmb's multilingual language set; no direct DeepParse address evaluation was found
script_scope.Lao: EMBEDDING_LEVEL_ONLY: Lao is in BPEmb's multilingual language set; no direct DeepParse address evaluation was found
script_scope.Thai: EMBEDDING_LEVEL_ONLY: Thai is in BPEmb's multilingual language set; no direct DeepParse address evaluation was found
